Name: New Leo for Vanilla and Seasonal Outfits
Author: rachelkel04
Description:
[size=4]
[b]Today I bring you my beloved parrot boy! [/b][/size][size=5]🦜🌟[/size]


[size=3]Leo has always been one of my favorite characters (I love the kids in Stardew in general). I find him incredibly adorable, his little parrot-like noises... he deserves the world and a makeover! :D[/size]

[size=3]His portraits differ from the other children's, so I wanted to give him a cuter, more childlike appearance, while still maintaining his jungle vibe.
[/size]
[size=2]
In the portraits, I altered his hair, eyes, clothes (some more than others), and a few other details.

In the sprites, I slightly modified his hair and some of his clothes based on the modifications I made in the portraits.[/size]

[code]﻿[/code]
[size=2]I made two versions of the files, one for vanilla Stardew Valley, and another for Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic.

If your case is the second one, just remember to disable the "Leo" option in the Seasonal Outfits settings.[/size]

[code]﻿[/code]
[size=5]Installation:[/size]

[list]
[*]Download the mod files and extract them to the Stardew Valley mods folder. (The path should be something like: C:\Program Files) Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
[/list][list]
[*]Run the game normally.
[/list]

I hope you like it! Feel free to comment if you have any feedback or if something isn't working. Thank you! 💖

[code]﻿[/code]
